name: GSAP
role: Paused, seekable timelines for DOM and SVG motion; the clock for every browser scene
summary: Animation library that writes CSS transforms and SVG attributes from a timeline you build once and seek from outside. In VCR every browser scene exposes one paused GSAP timeline; the capture harness seeks it frame by frame, so output is a pure function of time. Plugins cover motion along SVG paths, per-character text, stroke reveals and shape morphs.
use_when: Any DOM or SVG motion that must be seeked from outside: title cards, lower thirds, kinetic type
Over Anime.js when you need labels, nested timelines and the plugin set
Over CSS animations whenever frames must be captured deterministically
Orchestrating several elements against one clock with relative positions
avoid_when: Canvas or WebGL content: drive p5.js or Three.js from t directly instead
Spring physics is the point: Motion or React Spring sample springs natively
You need a visual curve editor: Theatre.js, then export values

facets.one_line: Build, nest, label and seek one paused timeline per scene
Named and custom easing curves and when each reads well
Move and auto-rotate elements along an SVG path
Per-character and per-line text animation, font-load safe

license: GSAP standard licence (free including plugins since 3.13; recheck)
